title: Ada and the Second Hello
youtube_title: Ada and the Second Hello | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smudge is not the end of a kind idea, and trying again can fill an empty mailbox with warmth.
summary: Ada wants to leave kind notes, but paint on her thumb smears the first one. Mei helps her wash up and write sunny notes for friends, including a spare hello so no mailbox feels left out.
